name: Feargus, the Capital
description: A city founded during the Fallen Age has seen better days. After the Imperial retreat, the city’s economy was greatly shaken. Many tents cover the open areas of the city, providing precarious shelter for its residents. Additionally, some structures made of wood and bone are suspended by ropes from elevated places, housing families. Security and various services are offered by groups of mercenaries and specialists from the clans, usually favoring those who can pay more. The city Arena is constantly being used to settle disputes between families and groups, usually ending up with some deaths. In contrast, Vharzog’s palace stands out as the sole magnific and opulent structure in the city, full of music and food. Xateri and her shamans reside in the palace, which is heavily fortified to prevent acts of rebellion. Vharzog enjoys this situation, as he can now stimulate the orcs’ brutal instinct through poverty. With no more nobles left to label as ‘the villains,’ he pins the blame on Katar, effectively creating an army through his manipulation.
